interface.shortDescription: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, p
interface.longDescription: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls the transcript from captions (or Whisper API fallback), and hands the result to Claude so it can answer questions about what's in the video.
